description: This file implements an image proxy service for Mattermost, including the ImageProxy class, backend interface, and related functions for URL handling and configuration management.

classes.name: ImageProxy
classes.description: Public interface for Mattermost's image proxy, managing configuration, URL translation, and backend interaction.

classes.name: ImageProxyBackend
classes.description: Interface defining backend methods for different image proxy implementations.

methods.name: MakeImageProxy
methods.description: Constructor for creating an ImageProxy instance with configuration and services.

methods.name: makeBackend
methods.description: Creates the appropriate backend based on proxy settings.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources and removes config listener.

methods.name: OnConfigChange
methods.description: Handles configuration updates, especially URL and backend changes.

methods.name: GetImage
methods.description: Requests an image through the proxy, responding via HTTP.

methods.name: GetImageDirect
methods.description: Returns a proxied image and its content type.

methods.name: GetProxiedImageURL
methods.description: Generates a URL to access an image via the proxy.

methods.name: GetUnproxiedImageURL
methods.description: Extracts the original image URL from a proxied URL.
